fields.Name: D1c -> S6.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.37 (phase 2, dataset D1c, criterion S6.4): on D1c each post-cutoff year of the holdout is its own out-of-time slice with a 95% interval on either side of its score, 100% of periods. It fails when post-cutoff periods are merged into one slice (fewer than 100% of periods).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Each post-cutoff year of D1c is its own slice with a 95% interval (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
